title: What The Sea Keeps v0.3 - new tiles, mechanics, improvements
author: Old-Wolverine-4134
selftext:
Added new tile types. Also we now have beach tiles that form sandy beaches. You can also notice the broken ship on the shore. It will be one of the main goals for the islanders to repair it. Occasionally some tiles bring with them ancient ruins that tell a story.

The lighthouse now needs repair before it lights up to bring another islander.

As the island gets bigger you will need more cards to bring up a tile. For instance you would need 2 land tiles placed on the same spot.

All is still very early dev, so there are all kinds of bugs.

All done in Unity with Opus 5.5

comments.author: Wooden_Plant7504
comments.body: Looking good. How long did it take you to reach that stage ? Where/How do you build the assets ?

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body: Around 4-5 days regular edits with sporadic small edits now and then. All build by Unity. Tried some stuff with blender, but at the end decided to use only Unity and everything is done in it, except the cards art from chatGPT

replies.author: Wooden_Plant7504
replies.body: Looks very good for 4-5 days...great work.
